items.title: LIIBA chief warns UK-EU reset deal could cut both ways for servicing European clients
items.summary: London and International Insurance Brokers' Association chief executive Chris Croft says reopening terms for serving EU clients carries risks as well as potential benefits following the UK-EU Brexit reset deal.

items.title: FCA issues warning over IRS Markets Clone firm
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has issued a warning against an unauthorised entity cloning the details of authorised firm 7IM Investment and Retirement Solutions Limited.

items.title: People moves in UK pensions for the week ending 20 November 2026
items.summary: Professional Pensions reports on recent appointments across the sector, including movements at Cartwright, Howden and People's Partnership.

items.title: One in five London MGAs plan continental Europe expansion by 2027
items.summary: DA Strategy expects new MGA launches across continental Europe in 2027 following a poll of London market webinar attendees.

items.title: Three-quarters of UK homeowners uncertain about underinsurance, Paymentshield research shows
items.summary: Paymentshield survey data reveals widespread homeowner confidence contrasted with a lack of awareness regarding rebuild costs and policy limitations.

items.title: The Swedish Club applies 4% general increase for 2027/28 policy year
items.summary: The Swedish Club lowers its P&I and FD&D general increase to 4% as marine mutual insurers moderate renewal demands.
